title: Isandro and the Orbit
author: Silas Dravenmoor
blurb: Emrys Oyelaran, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
